## 1. Shared helpers

```{r helpers}
library(caret)
data_dir <- "data"

prep_train_test <- function(csv_name, predictor_cols, split_seed = 42) {
  csv_data <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, csv_name), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  player_labels <- if ("Player" %in% names(csv_data)) {
    as.character(csv_data$Player)
  } else {
    paste0("Obs_", seq_len(nrow(csv_data)))
  }
  model_frame <- csv_data[, c("Drafted", predictor_cols), drop = FALSE]
  if ("Height" %in% names(model_frame)) {
    model_frame$Height <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(model_frame$Height)))
  }
  row_is_complete <- complete.cases(model_frame)
  model_frame <- model_frame[row_is_complete, , drop = FALSE]
  player_labels <- player_labels[row_is_complete]
  drafted_binary <- as.integer(model_frame$Drafted)
  predictor_matrix <- as.matrix(model_frame[, predictor_cols, drop = FALSE])
  set.seed(split_seed)
  n_players <- nrow(predictor_matrix)
  train_index <- sample.int(n_players, floor(0.8 * n_players))
  test_index <- setdiff(seq_len(n_players), train_index)
  predictors_train_only <- predictor_matrix[train_index, , drop = FALSE]
  train_column_sd <- apply(predictors_train_only, 2, sd)
  train_column_sd[train_column_sd == 0 | is.na(train_column_sd)] <- 1
  design_matrix <- cbind(
    1,
    scale(predictor_matrix, center = colMeans(predictors_train_only), scale = train_column_sd)
  )
  colnames(design_matrix) <- c("bias", predictor_cols)
  list(
    X_train = design_matrix[train_index, , drop = FALSE],
    y_train = drafted_binary[train_index],
    X_test = design_matrix[test_index, , drop = FALSE],
    y_test = drafted_binary[test_index],
    player_test = player_labels[test_index],
    pred_cols = predictor_cols,
    n = n_players
  )
}

sigmoid <- function(linear_predictor) {
  ifelse(
    linear_predictor >= 0,
    1 / (1 + exp(-linear_predictor)),
    exp(linear_predictor) / (1 + exp(linear_predictor))
  )
}

log_likelihood_logit <- function(coefficients, design_matrix, drafted_binary) {
  linear_predictor <- as.vector(design_matrix %*% coefficients)
  sum(drafted_binary * linear_predictor - log1p(exp(linear_predictor)))
}

log_prior <- function(coefficients, prior_variance_scale) {
  -0.5 * sum(coefficients^2) / prior_variance_scale
}

log_posterior <- function(coefficients, design_matrix, drafted_binary, prior_variance_scale) {
  log_likelihood_logit(coefficients, design_matrix, drafted_binary) +
    log_prior(coefficients, prior_variance_scale)
}

run_mh <- function(design_matrix, drafted_binary, n_iter, proposal_sd, prior_variance_scale, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n_coefficients <- ncol(design_matrix)
  current_coefficients <- rep(0, n_coefficients)
  mcmc_sample_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_iter, ncol = n_coefficients)
  colnames(mcmc_sample_matrix) <- colnames(design_matrix)
  log_posterior_current <- log_posterior(
    current_coefficients, design_matrix, drafted_binary, prior_variance_scale
  )
  n_accepted <- 0L

  for (iteration in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    proposed_coefficients <- current_coefficients + rnorm(n_coefficients, mean = 0, sd = proposal_sd)
    log_posterior_proposed <- log_posterior(
      proposed_coefficients, design_matrix, drafted_binary, prior_variance_scale
    )
    if (log(stats::runif(1)) < log_posterior_proposed - log_posterior_current) {
      current_coefficients <- proposed_coefficients
      log_posterior_current <- log_posterior_proposed
      n_accepted <- n_accepted + 1L
    }
    mcmc_sample_matrix[iteration, ] <- current_coefficients
  }

  acceptance_rate <- as.numeric(n_accepted) / n_iter
  cat(sprintf("Acceptance rate: %.3f\n", acceptance_rate))
  list(chain = mcmc_sample_matrix, acceptance_rate = acceptance_rate)
}

thin_chain <- function(full_chain, burn_in, thin) {
  full_chain[seq(burn_in + 1, nrow(full_chain), by = thin), , drop = FALSE]
}

posterior_quantile_table <- function(posterior_draws, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) {
  coef_quantiles <- apply(posterior_draws, 2, stats::quantile, probs = probs)
  data.frame(
    coefficient = colnames(posterior_draws),
    posterior_mean = colMeans(posterior_draws),
    q1 = as.numeric(coef_quantiles[1, ]),
    q2 = as.numeric(coef_quantiles[2, ]),
    q3 = as.numeric(coef_quantiles[3, ])
  )
}

plot_chain_acf <- function(parameter_trace, parameter_name = "parameter") {
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
  plot(parameter_trace, type = "l", main = sprintf("Convergence of %s", parameter_name),
       xlab = "Iteration", ylab = parameter_name)
  abline(h = mean(parameter_trace), col = "red", lty = 2)
  acf(parameter_trace, main = sprintf("ACF: %s", parameter_name))
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}

posterior_mean_prob_drafted <- function(design_matrix, posterior_draws) {
  linear_predictors <- design_matrix %*% t(posterior_draws)
  rowMeans(sigmoid(linear_predictors))
}

# Metrics
classification_metrics <- function(y_true, y_hat) {
  reference_factor <- factor(as.integer(y_true), levels = c(0L, 1L))
  predicted_factor <- factor(as.integer(y_hat), levels = c(0L, 1L))
  confusion_mat <- confusionMatrix(predicted_factor, reference_factor, positive = "1", mode = "everything")
  metrics_by_class <- confusion_mat$byClass
  list(
    accuracy = unname(confusion_mat$overall["Accuracy"]),
    precision = unname(metrics_by_class["Precision"]),
    recall = unname(metrics_by_class["Recall"]),
    f1 = unname(metrics_by_class["F1"])
  )
}

plot_test_dashboard <- function(y_test, probs, y_hat, player_names, threshold, main_title) {
  actual_drafted <- as.integer(y_test)
  predicted_drafted <- as.integer(y_hat)
  count_true_negative <- sum(actual_drafted == 0 & predicted_drafted == 0)
  count_false_negative <- sum(actual_drafted == 1 & predicted_drafted == 0)
  count_false_positive <- sum(actual_drafted == 0 & predicted_drafted == 1)
  count_true_positive <- sum(actual_drafted == 1 & predicted_drafted == 1)
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
  plot(0, 0, type = "n", xlim = c(0, 2), ylim = c(0, 2), asp = 1,
       xlab = "Actual", ylab = "Predicted", main = "Confusion",
       xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n")
  rect(0, 1, 1, 2, col = "wheat"); text(0.5, 1.5, count_true_negative, cex = 2)
  rect(1, 1, 2, 2, col = "wheat"); text(1.5, 1.5, count_false_negative, cex = 2)
  rect(0, 0, 1, 1, col = "wheat"); text(0.5, 0.5, count_false_positive, cex = 2)
  rect(1, 0, 2, 1, col = "wheat"); text(1.5, 0.5, count_true_positive, cex = 2)
  axis(1, at = c(0.5, 1.5), labels = c("Not drafted", "Drafted"))
  axis(2, at = c(0.5, 1.5), labels = c("Pred: drafted", "Pred: not"), las = 1)
  test_row_index <- seq_along(probs)
  plot(test_row_index, probs, pch = 19, col = ifelse(actual_drafted == 1, "darkgreen", "red"),
       xlab = "Test player (row)", ylab = "P(drafted)", main = main_title)
  abline(h = threshold, lty = 2)
  legend("topleft", legend = c("Was drafted", "Not drafted"), col = c("darkgreen", "red"), pch = 19, bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
  for (j in which(actual_drafted == 0 & predicted_drafted == 1)) {
    text(test_row_index[j], probs[j], player_names[j], pos = 3, cex = 0.55)
  }
  for (j in which(actual_drafted == 1 & predicted_drafted == 0)) {
    text(test_row_index[j], probs[j], player_names[j], pos = 1, cex = 0.55)
  }
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}
```

## 2. Fitting all positions


```{r fit-all, cache=TRUE}
default_tau_sq <- 1
default_prob_threshold <- 0.4

n_iter <- 25000
burn_in <- 5000
thin <- 5

position_config <- list(
  WR = list(
    file = "wr_data.csv",
    proposal_sd = 0.08,
    tau_sq = default_tau_sq,
    prob_threshold = default_prob_threshold,
    preds = c(
      "Height", "Weight", "40yd", "Vertical",
      "receiving_YDS", "receiving_TD", "receiving_YPR", "receiving_REC"
    )
  ),
  QB = list(
    file = "qb_data.csv",
    proposal_sd = 0.14,
    tau_sq = 0.5,
    prob_threshold = 0.45,
    preds = c(
      "Height", "Weight", "40yd", "Vertical",
      "passing_ATT", "passing_TD", "passing_YDS", "passing_YPA"
    )
  ),
  RB = list(
    file = "rb_data.csv",
    proposal_sd = 0.10,
    tau_sq = default_tau_sq,
    prob_threshold = 0.5,
    preds = c(
      "Height", "Weight", "40yd", "Vertical",
      "rushing_CAR", "rushing_YDS", "rushing_TD", "rushing_YPC"
    )
  ),
  DE = list(
    file = "de_data.csv",
    proposal_sd = 0.21,
    tau_sq = default_tau_sq,
    prob_threshold = 0.55,
    preds = c(
      "Height", "Weight", "40yd", "Vertical", "Bench",
      "defensive_SACKS", "defensive_TOT", "defensive_TFL"
    )
  ),
  CB = list(
    file = "cb_data.csv",
    proposal_sd = 0.12,
    tau_sq = default_tau_sq,
    prob_threshold = 0.55,
    preds = c(
      "Height", "Weight", "40yd", "Vertical", "Bench",
      "defensive_PD", "defensive_TOT", "interceptions_INT"
    )
  )
)

base_seed <- 42
fits <- list()
compare_rows <- list()

for (i in seq_along(position_config)) {
  pos <- names(position_config)[i]
  cfg <- position_config[[pos]]
  prep <- prep_train_test(cfg$file, cfg$preds, split_seed = 42 + i)
  tau_pos <- cfg$tau_sq
  thr <- cfg$prob_threshold
  mh <- run_mh(
    prep$X_train, prep$y_train,
    n_iter, cfg$proposal_sd, tau_pos,
    seed = base_seed + i
  )
  S <- thin_chain(mh$chain, burn_in = burn_in, thin = thin)

  ptr <- posterior_mean_prob_drafted(prep$X_train, S)
  pte <- posterior_mean_prob_drafted(prep$X_test, S)
  y_hat_train <- as.integer(ptr >= thr)
  y_hat_test <- as.integer(pte >= thr)

  m_tr <- classification_metrics(prep$y_train, y_hat_train)
  m_te <- classification_metrics(prep$y_test, y_hat_test)

  fits[[pos]] <- list(
    prep = prep,
    samples = S,
    acceptance_rate = mh$acceptance_rate,
    post_prob_test = pte,
    y_hat_train = y_hat_train,
    y_hat_test = y_hat_test,
    tau_sq = tau_pos,
    prob_threshold = thr,
    metrics_train = m_tr,
    metrics_test = m_te
  )

  compare_rows[[pos]] <- data.frame(
    position = pos,
    n = prep$n,
    n_train = nrow(prep$X_train),
    n_test = nrow(prep$X_test),
    p = ncol(prep$X_train),
    tau_sq = tau_pos,
    prob_threshold = thr,
    proposal_sd = cfg$proposal_sd,
    acceptance_rate = mh$acceptance_rate,
    acc_train = m_tr$accuracy,
    acc_test = m_te$accuracy,
    recall_train = m_tr$recall,
    recall_test = m_te$recall,
    f1_train = m_tr$f1,
    f1_test = m_te$f1,
    precision_train = m_tr$precision,
    precision_test = m_te$precision
  )
}

compare_tbl <- do.call(rbind, compare_rows)
rownames(compare_tbl) <- NULL
```

### Comparison across positions

```{r compare-kable}
tune_tbl <- compare_tbl[, c(
  "position", "n", "n_train", "n_test", "p",
  "tau_sq", "prob_threshold", "proposal_sd", "acceptance_rate"
)]
tune_tbl$tau_sq <- round(tune_tbl$tau_sq, 3)
tune_tbl$prob_threshold <- round(tune_tbl$prob_threshold, 3)
tune_tbl$proposal_sd <- round(tune_tbl$proposal_sd, 3)
tune_tbl$acceptance_rate <- round(tune_tbl$acceptance_rate, 3)
tune_tbl$acceptance_pct <- paste0(round(100 * compare_tbl$acceptance_rate, 1), "%")

knitr::kable(
  tune_tbl,
  col.names = c(
    "Position", "n", "n_train", "n_test", "p",
    "Prior tau_sq", "Prob. threshold", "Proposal SD", "Accept. rate", "Accept. rate (%)"
  ),
  caption = "Per-position tuning",
  align = "lrrrrrrrrr"
)

perf_tbl <- data.frame(
  Position = compare_tbl$position,
  train_pct_correct = paste0(round(100 * compare_tbl$acc_train, 1), "%"),
  test_pct_correct = paste0(round(100 * compare_tbl$acc_test, 1), "%"),
  train_recall = round(compare_tbl$recall_train, 3),
  test_recall = round(compare_tbl$recall_test, 3),
  train_f1 = round(compare_tbl$f1_train, 3),
  test_f1 = round(compare_tbl$f1_test, 3),
  train_precision = round(compare_tbl$precision_train, 3),
  test_precision = round(compare_tbl$precision_test, 3)
)

knitr::kable(
  perf_tbl,
  col.names = c(
    "Position",
    "Train % correct", "Test % correct",
    "Train recall", "Test recall",
    "Train F1", "Test F1",
    "Train precision", "Test precision"
  ),
  caption = "Train/test metrics.",
  align = "lrrrrrrrr"
)
```


```{r test-dashboards, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.8, fig.keep='all'}
pos_labels <- c(
  WR = "Wide receiver", QB = "Quarterback", RB = "Running back",
  DE = "Defensive end", CB = "Cornerback"
)
for (pos in names(position_config)) {
  fit <- fits[[pos]]
  pr <- fit$prep
  plot_test_dashboard(
    pr$y_test, fit$post_prob_test, fit$y_hat_test, pr$player_test,
    fit$prob_threshold, paste0(pos_labels[[pos]], " (", pos, ") - test")
  )
}
```

## 3. WR 

```{r wr-detail, fig.height = 4}
S <- fits$WR$samples
pr <- fits$WR$prep
plot_chain_acf(S[, "bias"], parameter_name = "bias (WR)")

knitr::kable(
  posterior_quantile_table(S),
  digits = 3,
  caption = "WR: posterior summaries"
)

cat("WR test confusion (row = actual, col = predicted):\n")
print(table(actual = pr$y_test, predicted = fits$WR$y_hat_test))
```
